salivan_p18_21.issue: negation scope reversed + 'for some reason' mistranslated
salivan_p18_21.why: EN: "For some reason i'm not always sure of the source of the move. (how to correctly identify it)." FA: "دلیلی دارد که همیشه از منبع حرکت مطمئن نیستم." Two changes of meaning: (a) "not always sure" (occasional doubt) becomes "همیشه ... مطمئن نیستم" (never sure); (b) "for some reason" (نمی‌دانم چرا) becomes the assertion "دلیلی دارد که" (there is a reason that), which the English does not claim.
